answer_1.quote: We introduce a novel task and parallel bench-mark datasets of factoid QA to evaluate "Reasoning by Equivalence" in LLMs and assess the performance of multiple SOTA LLMs on this task across 6 languages (English, French, Spanish, German, Portuguese and Hindi).
answer_1.outputs: LLM-generated answers to factoid questions in multiple languages

answer_2.quote: We compute the conflicts among answers generated by LLM for different input/output expression languages. We define conflict rate between (r_i, r_j) language pair as fraction of total answer pairs which are conflicting
